engine_start: engine.py:131, after engine construction, configuration validation, path protection and output-directory creation; before input prepare/decompression
engine_stop: engine.py:209, after final tree/support export and quality construction; before final RESULT.json and completion event
gpu_completion: Explicit torch.cuda.synchronize after AP-NJ, MSC setup and MSC search; required CPU export follows.
limitations: Single execution per input, two simultaneous physical GPU workers; not repeated isolated performance measurement.
Startup, imports, runtime configuration and final process shutdown are outside engine timing.
Both CLI and engine metrics exclude queue time and upload time.
Initial compilation/install in an empty environment is not characterized.
Historical refinement-only times cannot be used as full-pipeline denominators.
